# Question 5

```{r}
sd <- 0.5
x_vect <- runif(200, min=-1, max=1)
y_vect <- 2 - 3*(x_vect) + rnorm(200, mean=0, sd)

x_vect_1 <- cbind(1, x_vect)
beta <- solve(t(x_vect_1) %*% x_vect_1) %*% t(x_vect_1) %*% y_vect
print(paste("beta: ",beta))
variance <- sd * solve(t(x_vect_1) %*% x_vect_1)
theoretical_sd <- variance ^ (0.5)
print(paste("theoretical standard deviation", theoretical_sd))

fit1 <- lm(y_vect~x_vect)
summary(fit1)
```
